Initial release of AI Tamagotchi:

- Raise an AI-powered virtual pet with 73+ species, real-time hunger, and permanent death.

- Track your pet’s status (hunger, happiness, health, trust, etc.) live.
- View and interact with pets and the graveyard at animalhouse.ai.
